sloka: एवमेतत्कपिश्रेष्ठ भविता नात्र संशयः ।चरिष्यति कथा यावदेषा लोके च मामिका ।तावत्ते भविता कीर्तिः शरीरे ऽप्यसवस्तथा ।। ७.४०.२० ॥
transliteration: evametatkapiśreṣṭha bhavitā nātra saṁśayaḥ ।cariṣyati kathā yāvadeṣā loke ca māmikā ।tāvatte bhavitā kīrtiḥ śarīre 'pyasavastathā ।। 7.40.20 ॥

translations.english: O best of monkeys, it will indeed be so, there is no doubt about it; as long as this story of mine spreads in the world, so long will your fame and life-breaths remain in your body.
